recommendations.guidance: Prefer clear general instructions and outcome constraints over hand-written reasoning recipes unless strict sequencing is genuinely required.

evidence.note: Anthropic recommends general instructions over prescriptive steps for current Claude models.

recommendations.guidance: Remove legacy blanket self-check or verification instructions when they cause over-verification; define concrete completion criteria instead.
avoid: generic before-you-finish self-check prompts copied from older-model harnesses

evidence.note: Anthropic documents Claude Opus 5 as self-verifying well and warns older verification prompts can add latency/tokens through over-verification.

recommendations.guidance: Specify when subagent delegation is useful and when direct work is preferred; avoid treating delegation as mandatory for simple exploration.

evidence.note: Anthropic notes Claude Opus 5 delegates to subagents more readily than prior models and provides control guidance.
